description: Phase 2 monitoring: every typed refusal code in frontend/functions/src/lib/errors.js, in exactly one class. The class decides whether a refusal can raise an alert. Pinned by frontend/tests/unit/phase2Monitoring.test.js against errors.js and against the filters of the policy and metric files in this folder. A code added to errors.js must be classified here before that suite passes.

baselineFailure.meaning: A project's historical baseline cannot be established or is not usable. Every operation of that family stays refused in that project until it is reviewed. Never an ordinary user error.

financialInconsistency.meaning: Stored records, a ledger or an invariant do not reconcile, or a stored record is not shaped as Constrap writes one. The operation was refused and nothing was written; the data needs review. client-ledger-invariant is also raised when a requested posting or void would itself breach an invariant (the refusal log line does not say which).

contention.alert: phase2-contention-repeated.policy.json (threshold, not on a single refusal)
contention.meaning: Nothing was written because the same records were being changed at the same time (after the SDK's own retries, up to 5 attempts), or because a historical baseline or an estimate build was in progress, superseded or abandoned (supplier-finance-busy carries reason baseline-in-progress / baseline-superseded / baseline-source-changed, which is NOT in the log line). One is ordinary; a run of them is not.

switchOff.alert: none - an emergency brake is off; HTTP 503, so it is ALSO counted by phase2-callable-server-failure.policy.json (see the README)
switchOff.meaning: A global switch is false. Expected from Stage B until Stage F, and whenever the Product Owner pulls a brake.

notActivated.meaning: The caller's company is not activated (commercialCompletionEnabled / clientFinanceEnabled). Expected for every inactive company: its Phase 2 registers are read-only.

businessRefusal.meaning: An ordinary refusal: authentication, permission, validation, a stale review, a cap or limit, a dependency, approval segregation, an id conflict. The user is told what to do; nothing was written.

teamOnly.alert: none - not answered by any financial callable
